title: Separate complete preservation from rare false acceptance
statement: Given H=A sigma-B rho,positive gap g0 and program weights<=W,coherent uncomputation preserves arbitrary-rank P in complete norm<=xi and acceptance<=3Tr(P input)+3Wxi/16. Fresh cap131072ell²S²/xi+4Lrm and consistency g0rank(P)<=AW; rejection is ERASED.

requires: Independent mixed copies, controlled full-register SWAPs and coherent known ancilla gates. P=1_(0,infinity)(H),ell=A+B,g0<=ell,0<W<=1,0<xi<=1. Gap/weight promises supplied, not certified. No unknown eigenbasis or physical support oracle.
provides: Given H=A sigma-B rho,positive gap g0 and program weights<=W,coherent uncomputation preserves arbitrary-rank P in complete norm<=xi and acceptance<=3Tr(P input)+3Wxi/16. Fresh cap131072ell²S²/xi+4Lrm and consistency g0rank(P)<=AW; rejection is ERASED.
assumptions: Consistency requires g0 rank(P)<=A W. Logarithmic W removes an EXTRA inverse-rarity penalty beyond gap cost; it is not rarity-independent complexity. Rejection is ERASED: this corollary is not a retained-rejection black box. No relative diamond bound for arbitrary P/complement superpositions, decoder or arbitrary many-term Hamiltonian extension.
costs: Charge every fresh training program, forward/reverse simulation, rejected/early-stop branches, original noisy datum (+1 call), validation/startup, preparation, holding/memory and classical processing. Gate width/storage depend on output dimension even when sample count does not. Each datum consumes a new bank; no free batching or demonstrated practical advantage. General cap131072 ell²S²/xi+4Lrm,S=2Lr pi(M-1)/ell,M>=128ell/g0; scale O(ell²/(g0²xi)) times explicit logs. The4,-6 specialization has its OWN phase/time convention, cap131072S²/xi+4Lrm. Reverse-time uncomputation uses fresh copies.
